title: WA: Interstate WWC Bans Now Recognised (Banned in One, Banned in All)
body: Changes to WA's Working with Children Check laws are now in effect, so a negative WWC Check decision in another Australian state or territory is now also recognised in WA. There is no transition period. People with such a decision must stop child-related work once their WA application is withdrawn or card cancelled, and they can't use exemptions such as the child or parent volunteer exemption. Clubs that become aware a volunteer or employee has such a decision must immediately make sure they stop child-related work, and should use the updated volunteer declaration template.
verifiedQuote: Under these changes, if a person receives an adverse WWC Check decision in another Australian state or territory, that decision will also be recognised in WA. Put simply: banned in one, banned in all.
